context.description: FASLG input on a fixed External_Activator=1 background; every other external input0.
context.source_anchor: Results and Discussion, Figure6B (logical follow-through from the FASLG input).
context.rationale: FASLG is the second explicitly traced input in Figure6. Preserve the same declared availability background as the IFNG condition. Direct caspase, mitochondrial and transcription-factor activator inputs remain0; any resulting model response must arise through the retained logical rules. No apoptotic phenotype is assumed in advance.
context.biological_interpretation: Prespecified Boolean coordinate condition; not an experimentally established full phenotype or reproduction of a published stochastic input environment.

source.variable_names_note: Node order is derived from BNET left-hand sides and referenced inputs. The metadata variable-names list may omit output coordinates and is not used as the complete node list.

eligibility: All regulated coordinates, including outputs and phenotypic nodes, are eligible for additional target-value pins. No gene-only or molecular-actuator restriction is imposed.
dynamics: Synchronous Boolean update; omitted input rules explicitly completed as identities; static target pins applied from time zero.
target_scope: Computational fixed point found by the declared orbit for the frozen input context; not asserted to be a validated biological phenotype.

search.work_definition: One unit per original residual successor evaluated plus one per compatible state in each candidate pin-set classification. Reserved work includes interrupted candidate work conservatively.
search.feasible_upper_bound_reason: Pinning every original residual coordinate is globally sufficient by physical residual equivalence.

transient_bound_interpretation: A proved uniform upper bound from an empty full support and/or baseline capture plus exact residual hitting time; not claimed to be the attained worst transient of the original full network.
total_cost_interpretation: Identity inputs are individually mandatory for convergence from every compatible initial state before input clamping; total cost adds those mandatory input clamps to the conditional additional optimum/bounds.
